headline: Compuage Infocom Limited: 26th COC Meeting Outcomes in CIRP
sum: Compuage Infocom Limited disclosed outcomes of its 26th Committee of Creditors (COC) meeting under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), signalling material progress in the insolvency proceedings initiated against the software and IT services company.
detail: Compuage Infocom Limited, an IT services and software solutions company, is in active CIRP. The disclosure of the 26th COC meeting outcome via NSE intimation letter signals multiple rounds of creditor deliberation and resolution plan evaluation. The frequency of COC meetings (26 by July 2026) suggests complex stakeholder negotiations, potential plan rejections, or extended timelines. No resolution plan acceptance or liquidation declaration has been publicly announced as of this disclosure.
